about.zh: 图像差分在对应位置和通道比较读数。带符号的差保留变化方向，绝对差保留变化大小。数值和位置是不同信息，图像算术逐位置执行。
about.en: Image differencing compares corresponding locations and channels. Signed difference retains direction; absolute difference retains size. Values and positions are distinct; image arithmetic acts at matching locations.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; L3 PDF pp6–7 (point operations); absolute value is mathematical support

wall.zh: 怎样同时发现比参照更亮和更暗的变化？
wall.en: How can both brighter and darker changes be retained?

misconception.zh: 只留下正变化，或把负数显示成黑色就认为没有变化。
misconception.en: Keeping only positive changes, or treating clipped negative display values as no change.

about.zh: 逐位置比较需要同一场景位置对应。这里约定输出 (x,y) 读取输入 (x+dx,y+dy)，x 向右、y 向下为正；有限图像之外的值来自边界假设。
about.en: Pointwise comparison requires corresponding scene locations. Here output (x,y) reads input (x+dx,y+dy), with x right and y down. Outside values follow an explicit boundary assumption.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md PDF pp22–26; spatial-read convention is a declared task assumption

wall.zh: 怎样避免把已知错位当作缺陷？
wall.en: How can a known displacement be excluded from defect evidence?

misconception.zh: 给像素值加 dx 就是在移动图像。
misconception.en: Adding dx to pixel values moves the image.

about.zh: 线性局部运算把邻域的对应读数与权重相乘后相加。位置和符号有意义；对恒定输入，权重和决定输出增益。
about.en: A linear local operation sums position-matched weighted readings. Positions and signs matter; the weight sum determines constant-input gain.

wall.zh: 怎样让多个邻居分别贡献到一个输出？
wall.en: How can several neighbours contribute separately to one output?

misconception.zh: 交换左右权重不会改变结果，或者所有权重都必须为正并且总和为 1。
misconception.en: Swapping side weights has no effect, or all filters must have positive unit-sum weights.

about.zh: 若二维核是两个一维权重向量的外积，可以先后沿两轴计算，减少每个像素的加权次数。非可分离核不能直接这样替代；有限图像要保持相同边界与输出域。
about.en: An outer-product kernel can be applied as consecutive 1D passes, reducing weighted samples per pixel. Nonseparable kernels cannot be replaced this way, and boundaries/domains must agree.

wall.zh: 怎样复用一维处理得到二维邻域，而不遗漏角点？
wall.en: How can a 1D construction cover a 2D neighbourhood including corners?

misconception.zh: 两条轴各处理一次再相加就等于二维平均。
misconception.en: Adding independent axis outputs is a 2D average.

about.zh: 互相关将书写核按中心对齐邻域，保持核的书写方向，计算对应元素乘积之和。核尺寸决定支持域，权重决定响应。
about.en: Correlation centres a written kernel without reversing it and sums matching products. Kernel size determines support; weights determine response.

wall.zh: 怎样用同一个电路处理不同形状的局部规则？
wall.en: How can one circuit implement different local rules?

misconception.zh: 权重乘完之后还要再平均一次，或表中每行是一整张新图。
misconception.en: Averaging after weighting, or treating each table row as a separate full image.

about.zh: 图像梯度由两条空间轴的偏导数组成，离散差分近似它们。分量的正负保留变化方向，核约定与坐标方向必须明确。
about.en: An image gradient contains derivatives along both spatial axes, approximated by differences. Signs retain direction; kernel and coordinate conventions must be explicit.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

wall.zh: 怎样分辨横向、纵向以及相反方向的变化？
wall.en: How can axis and sign of change be distinguished?

misconception.zh: 把同一张变化图当作两个方向，或者忽略负响应。
misconception.en: Using one response for both axes, or discarding negative responses.

about.zh: 多通道图像在每个位置有多个读数。跨通道加权和将它们组合为新的测量，空间索引保持不变；多个输出核可以形成多个输出通道。
about.en: A multi-channel image contains several readings per position. A weighted channel sum combines them into a measurement without changing positions; multiple output kernels can form multiple channels.

wall.zh: 怎样从彩色读数形成扫描器使用的单通道测量？
wall.en: How can colour readings become a scalar scanner measurement?

misconception.zh: 只取某一通道总能代替颜色组合，或通道混合会移动像素。
misconception.en: One channel always suffices, or mixing channels moves pixels.

about.zh: 余弦波可写成 A cos(2π(kx/N+p))。k 控制整行周期数，A 控制幅度，p 控制相位；这里相位以周为单位。波形的负值仍是有效计算数据。
about.en: A cosine wave is A cos(2π(kx/N+p)): k controls cycles per row, A amplitude and p phase. This interface measures phase in turns. Negative wave values remain valid data.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md PDF pp7–21; turns are the declared mathematical unit

wall.zh: 怎样分别控制重复速度和波形的位置关系？
wall.en: How can repetition rate and wave alignment be controlled independently?

misconception.zh: 频率是统一加到每个位置的偏移。
misconception.en: Frequency is an offset added to every position.

about.zh: 将信号与基函数相乘并累加，可测量该方向的投影系数。这里按行长归一化为平均值；异频项在完整离散周期上正交抵消。单一相位只能测到一个方向。
about.en: Multiplication and accumulation measure a signal’s projection onto a basis. Here the coefficient is normalised by row length. Different discrete frequencies are orthogonal across complete cycles; a single phase measures only one direction.

wall.zh: 怎样判断观测中某个频率的贡献？
wall.en: How can an observation’s contribution at a frequency be measured?

misconception.zh: 探针自己有波形就能测量，或一次零响应等于频率不存在。
misconception.en: The basis alone measures the signal, or one zero response proves absence.

about.zh: 离散傅里叶系数的实部投影到 cos，虚部投影到 −sin。幅度是两分量的长度，相位由两分量的关系确定；这里只用归一化系数，不把系数幅度直接叫作波的峰值幅度。
about.en: The DFT real part projects onto cos and the imaginary part onto −sin. Their length is coefficient magnitude and their relationship determines phase. Normalised coefficient magnitude is not automatically the sinusoid’s peak amplitude.

wall.zh: 怎样在条纹发生平移后仍保留频率信息？
wall.en: How can frequency information survive stripe translation?

misconception.zh: 重复同一投影可以补齐相位，或系数幅度足够重建原图。
misconception.en: Duplicating one projection recovers phase, or magnitude alone reconstructs the image.

about.zh: 逆变换把各频率按复数系数组合。这里前向除以 N、逆向直接求和；实输出为 Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin)。只保留幅度通常不能还原原有空间关系。
about.en: Inverse transformation combines frequencies using complex coefficients. This convention divides forward by N and sums inverse terms: Σ(Re·cos−Im·sin) for real output. Magnitude alone usually loses spatial relationships.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/04-fourier.md Fourier transform and magnitude/phase PDF pp18–34

wall.zh: 怎样验证频谱仍保留原图的空间信息？
wall.en: How can the spectrum be checked for retained spatial information?

misconception.zh: 逆向也要平均，或者把虚部符号照搬为同相余弦。
misconception.en: Averaging in both directions, or using the wrong imaginary contribution.

about.zh: 二维 DFT 可分解为两条轴的完整复数一维变换。每条频率轴描述相应空间方向的变化；本约定总前向归一化为 1/(WH)。
about.en: The 2D DFT separates into complete complex 1D transforms along both axes. Frequency axes correspond to spatial variation; this convention normalises forward by 1/(WH).

wall.zh: 怎样把逐行频谱仪扩展到真正的二维图像？
wall.en: How can a row analyser become a true 2D analyser?

misconception.zh: 第二次仍沿原来的行处理，或不恢复原图轴顺序。
misconception.en: Transforming original rows twice, or failing to restore axis order.

about.zh: 频域滤波以逐频率增益乘复数系数再逆变换。低通保留接近零的频率，高通去掉低频，带通保留一个范围；实输出要求增益与共轭对称一致。
about.en: Frequency filtering multiplies complex coefficients by gains before inversion. Low-pass keeps frequencies near zero, high-pass removes low frequencies, and band-pass keeps a range. Real output requires conjugate-consistent gains.

wall.zh: 怎样改变尺度贡献而不误改相位或漏掉负频率？
wall.en: How can scale contributions be changed without corrupting phase or missing negative frequencies?

misconception.zh: 只调整实部，或者负索引天然属于低频。
misconception.en: Adjusting only real components, or treating every negative index as low frequency.

about.zh: 空间卷积对应频域复数逐点乘积。离散有限实现需匹配周期/补边约定、核原点、输出域和归一化；本例对每行使用周期卷积。
about.en: Spatial convolution corresponds to pointwise complex frequency multiplication. Finite implementations must match periodic/padding conventions, kernel origin, output domain and normalisation. This task uses circular row convolution.

wall.zh: 怎样证明自己的频域路径实现了同一条空间规则？
wall.en: How can the frequency path be verified against the same spatial rule?

misconception.zh: 把周期频域结果与零边界卷积比较，认为差异就是算法错误。
misconception.en: Comparing periodic frequency processing with zero-boundary convolution as if they were the same problem.

about.zh: 测量输出保留变化量，判定根据任务给定的准则将证据转为标记。阈值比较不是对物体语义或缺陷成因的推断。
about.en: Measurements retain change values; a task criterion turns evidence into a decision mask. Thresholding does not infer object meaning or defect cause.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/02-basics.md image arrays; L3 point operations; inspection/tolerance is a controlled application

wall.zh: 怎样从变化量得到任务需要的标记？
wall.en: How is change magnitude turned into the required task output?

misconception.zh: 测量值本身就是缺陷类别，或者零与非零足以处理所有读数波动。
misconception.en: Treating measurements as defect classes, or assuming every nonzero change must fail.

about.zh: 数学离散卷积使用反转的核，相比互相关需将核旋转 180 度。非对称核揭示方向差别；对称核会隐藏它。
about.en: Discrete mathematical convolution reverses the kernel: rotate it 180 degrees relative to correlation. Asymmetric kernels reveal the difference; symmetric ones hide it.

wall.zh: 怎样让处理器执行公式所指的卷积，而不是方向相反的响应？
wall.en: How can the processor follow the mathematical convolution convention?

misconception.zh: 对称模糊结果一致，就认为卷积和互相关没有区别。
misconception.en: Assuming convolution and correlation are identical because symmetric blurs agree.

about.zh: 有限图像没有图外观测。零、复制、周期和镜像代表不同延续模型；valid 只保留完整邻域，因此输出尺寸依核支持缩小。
about.en: Finite images have no outside observations. Zero, replicate, periodic and reflected extension are different models. Valid output keeps full neighbourhoods and shrinks with support.

wall.zh: 怎样避免边界模型制造额外证据？
wall.en: How can boundary assumptions avoid creating spurious evidence?

misconception.zh: 所有补边只影响外观，或保持原宽高的补边等于 valid。
misconception.en: Padding only affects appearance, or same-size padding is equivalent to valid output.

about.zh: Sobel 沿一轴差分、沿垂直轴平滑，组成二维方向核。梯度长度为 sqrt(gx²+gy²)，区别于有符号相加。尺度、噪声和边界都会影响响应。
about.en: Sobel combines a derivative along one axis with smoothing along the other. Gradient length is sqrt(gx²+gy²), not signed addition. Scale, noise and boundaries affect responses.

knowledge.source: docs/Unimelb/26S2/CV/03-filters.md PDF pp29–30; L5 PDF pp39–42

wall.zh: 怎样把方向测量组合成稳定、不会因符号抵消的响应？
wall.en: How can directional measurements form a stable response without sign cancellation?

misconception.zh: 应沿求导轴再次平均，或用 gx+gy 代替长度。
misconception.en: Smoothing along the derivative axis, or replacing length with gx+gy.

about.zh: 离散频谱保留全部基函数投影。这里前向按 N 归一化，DC 位于索引 0；实信号的 k 与 N−k 系数互为共轭，索引应按周期解释。
about.en: The discrete spectrum retains all basis projections. This convention normalises forward coefficients by N and stores DC at index 0. For real signals, k and N−k are conjugate and indices are periodic.

wall.zh: 怎样把一个频率的测量扩展为完整、仍可重建的表示？
wall.en: How can one-frequency measurement become a complete reconstructible representation?

misconception.zh: 把取样位置当作频率索引，或只保留一半而不说明如何恢复。
misconception.en: Confusing sample positions with frequency indices, or discarding half the data without a recovery rule.

about.zh: 平移可在保留频谱幅度时改变相位。幅度和相位共同决定重建，交换相位会改变结构；频谱为零的位置没有可定义的相位方向。
about.en: Translation can change phase while retaining magnitudes. Both determine reconstruction; phase exchange changes structure. Zero coefficients have no defined phase direction.

wall.zh: 为什么相同幅度不能唯一确定图像？
wall.en: Why do equal magnitudes not uniquely determine an image?

misconception.zh: 幅度就是可重建的完整频谱，虚部是无用噪声。
misconception.en: Magnitude is the complete reconstructible spectrum and imaginary components are noise.

about.zh: 比较两张同尺寸图，输出逐位置、逐通道的绝对差。
about.en: Compare equal-size images using per-location, per-channel absolute difference.

about.zh: 按给定 dx、dy 读取观测，再与参照逐位置比较；图外取 0。
about.en: Read an observation at dx,dy offsets and compare with the reference, using zero outside.

about.zh: 沿所选空间轴，按前侧、中心、后侧权重汇合三格读数。横向对应左中右，纵向对应上中下；图外规则可设置。
about.en: Combine three readings along the selected axis: left/centre/right for x, above/centre/below for y, with explicit borders.

about.zh: 把同一组三点权重沿两轴先后应用，运行你的三点加权电路。
about.en: Apply the same three weights consecutively along both axes using your weighted-line circuit.

about.zh: 将权重表直接对齐邻域并求加权和。运行你自己的电路，图外规则可设置。
about.en: Compute written-order weighted neighbourhood sums using your circuit, with explicit borders.

about.zh: 翻转书写核后运行自己的互相关器，图外规则可设置。
about.en: Reverse the written kernel and run your correlator with explicit borders.

about.zh: 用给定横向数学差分核及其转置，给出 gx、gy；图外规则可设置。
about.en: Apply a supplied derivative kernel and its transpose to obtain gx and gy, with explicit borders.

about.zh: 运行你的差分、垂直平滑与长度电路，输出 gx、gy 和强度；核和图外规则显式给出。
about.en: Run your derivative, perpendicular-smoothing and length circuit; expose gx, gy and strength with explicit kernel/borders.

about.zh: 按输入 wr、wg、wb 汇合 RGB，运行你自己的跨通道加权电路。
about.en: Combine RGB with wr,wg,wb using your passed channel-weighting circuit.

about.zh: 按位置、频率和相位输出单位幅度余弦波，角度以周计。
about.en: Generate unit-amplitude cosine readings from positions, frequency and phase in turns.

about.zh: 输出各行观测与指定波形的平均乘积，保留正负。
about.en: Return each row’s signed mean product with the specified basis wave.

about.zh: 保留指定频率的归一化实部、虚部及系数长度。
about.en: Retain normalised real, imaginary and magnitude components at a specified frequency.

about.zh: 用你的正交探针遍历全部频率，输出每行归一化频谱。
about.en: Scan all frequencies with your quadrature probe to produce normalised row spectra.

about.zh: 按归一化实部、虚部系数合成图像，复用你的波形电路。
about.en: Reconstruct from normalised real and imaginary coefficients using your wave circuit.

about.zh: 复用两次自己的逐行频谱仪，接收并输出实部、虚部。
about.en: Reuse your row analyser on real/imaginary inputs and retain both outputs.

about.zh: 沿两轴复用自己的复数逐行变换，输出归一化的实部、虚部与幅度。
about.en: Reuse your complex row transform along both axes and retain normalised real, imaginary and magnitude outputs.

about.zh: 用自己的频谱仪、双分量增益与重建器处理每行。
about.en: Filter rows using your analyser, paired component gains and synthesiser.

about.zh: 通过共轭与 W×H 缩放复用自己的二维频谱仪，输出实部和虚部残差。
about.en: Reuse your 2D analyser through conjugation and WH scaling; retain real output and imaginary residual.

question.zh: 怎样让图像读数变成可靠的变化证据？
question.en: How can image readings become useful change evidence?

why.zh: 你接手一台图像质检台。它能展示待检图和合格参照，却还不能指出哪里发生了变化。先造一个比较部件：同一位置、同一通道的读数对应起来。这里光照固定，图像已经对齐；小数表示读数，不要求手算。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>
why.en: You inherit an image inspection station. It shows an observation and a good reference, but cannot indicate changes. Build a comparator using matching locations and channels. Lighting is fixed and images are aligned; decimals are measurements, not a calculation exercise. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>

title.en: Give the inspection station a comparison

task.zh: 质检同时关注变亮和变暗。输出每格变化的大小；相同位置输出 0。
task.en: Inspection must retain both brightening and darkening. Output change size at each cell; unchanged cells give 0.

question.zh: 怎样同时发现比参照更亮和更暗的变化？
question.en: How can both brighter and darker changes be retained?

chain.zh: 你接手一台图像质检台。它能展示待检图和合格参照，却还不能指出哪里发生了变化。先造一个比较部件：同一位置、同一通道的读数对应起来。这里光照固定，图像已经对齐；小数表示读数，不要求手算。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: You inherit an image inspection station. It shows an observation and a good reference, but cannot indicate changes. Build a comparator using matching locations and channels. Lighting is fixed and images are aligned; decimals are measurements, not a calculation exercise. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先观察一个变亮和一个变暗的位置。数值计算自动完成。
chain.en: Inspect one brighter and one darker location. Arithmetic is automatic.

chain.zh: 差异图保留变化发生的位置，绝对值同时保留变亮和变暗的证据。它还不能区分缺陷、错位与光照变化；这些需要额外假设。 <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A difference image localises change; absolute value retains both brighter and darker changes. It does not distinguish defects, misalignment and lighting without additional assumptions. <wiki-ref to="image-difference"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 只留下正变化，或把负数显示成黑色就认为没有变化。
naive.en: Keeping only positive changes, or treating clipped negative display values as no change.

task.zh: 夹具给出了取样偏移 dx、dy。先按它读取观测图，再与参照比较；图外取 0。
task.en: The fixture supplies sampling offsets dx and dy. Read the observation at those offsets before comparing with the reference; outside reads are zero.

question.zh: 怎样避免把已知错位当作缺陷？
question.en: How can a known displacement be excluded from defect evidence?

chain.zh: 传送带移动了工件，直接比较会把移动也标成变化。夹具已经测出取样偏移，不需要你估计位移。给比较器补上位置对应，再用真正的缺口检验它。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The conveyor moved the item, so direct comparison reports motion as change. A fixture already measured the sampling offset; you do not estimate it. Add correspondence before comparison and test a real defect. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 正 dx 表示输出 (x,y) 读取观测的 (x+dx,y+dy)，不表示把亮度加上 dx。
chain.en: Positive dx means output (x,y) reads observation (x+dx,y+dy); it does not add dx to brightness.

chain.zh: 已知对齐信息可以消除这部分错位证据，但没有凭空解决未知图像配准。位置变换与亮度运算承担不同职责。 <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Known alignment removes that source of mismatch; it does not solve unknown image registration. Position changes and intensity arithmetic play different roles. <wiki-ref to="spatial-correspondence"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 给像素值加 dx 就是在移动图像。
naive.en: Adding dx to pixel values moves the image.

task.zh: 容差由质检规范给定。输出对齐差异，以及严格超过容差的变化标记（1）；其余为 0。
task.en: Tolerance is supplied by the inspection specification. Output aligned differences and a 1 only where a difference strictly exceeds tolerance.

question.zh: 怎样从变化量得到任务需要的标记？
question.en: How is change magnitude turned into the required task output?

chain.zh: 比较器已经能处理夹具给出的错位，现在把它接入质检规范。图像中的变化证据与最终的通过条件不是一回事：相机小幅读数波动在规范允许范围内。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The comparator handles the fixture offset. Connect it to the inspection specification: measured change and a decision condition are different. Small reading fluctuations are allowed. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先检查差异输出，再检查比较的两个输入谁在前。小于元件在 a<b 时输出 1。
chain.en: Check the difference first, then the order of the comparison inputs. Less returns 1 when a<b.

chain.zh: 机器把对齐、比较和规范判断分开，便于检查哪一环出了问题。结论只适用于给定光照、对齐信息与容差的受控任务。 <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Alignment, comparison and decision are separate and inspectable. The conclusion applies only to this controlled lighting, alignment and tolerance specification. <wiki-ref to="decision-evidence"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 测量值本身就是缺陷类别，或者零与非零足以处理所有读数波动。
naive.en: Treating measurements as defect classes, or assuming every nonzero change must fail.

question.zh: 怎样把邻居、方向与通道装成扫描响应？
question.en: How can neighbours, directions and channels form scanner responses?

why.zh: 质检台只能逐位置比较，无法利用周围读数区分细碎干扰和较大结构。这章要造邻域处理器，再把它装成扫描器。先从三个位置开始：取样位置与贡献权重分开，所有数值由电路计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
why.en: The station compares individual locations but cannot use surrounding readings to separate fine nuisance from broader structure. Build a neighbourhood processor and then a scanner. Start with three positions: sample locations and contributions are separate; the circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

task.zh: 用给定的位置权重组合左、中、右三个读数。输出与输入同尺寸，图外取 0；权重不必总为正，也不自动归一化。
task.en: Combine left, centre and right readings with the supplied positional weights. Keep image size, read zero outside, and do not automatically normalise or discard negative weights.

question.zh: 怎样让多个邻居分别贡献到一个输出？
question.en: How can several neighbours contribute separately to one output?

chain.zh: 质检台只能逐位置比较，无法利用周围读数区分细碎干扰和较大结构。这章要造邻域处理器，再把它装成扫描器。先从三个位置开始：取样位置与贡献权重分开，所有数值由电路计算。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The station compares individual locations but cannot use surrounding readings to separate fine nuisance from broader structure. Build a neighbourhood processor and then a scanner. Start with three positions: sample locations and contributions are separate; the circuit does the arithmetic. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 亮点能显示谁贡献到哪个位置；先把三路分别接到输出观察，再组合。
chain.en: An impulse reveals which sample contributes where. Inspect the branches before combining them.

chain.zh: 邻域处理将多个位置的信息汇合。权重的位置、正负与总和分别影响方向、响应和恒定区域增益；不是所有权重都应归一化。 <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Neighbourhood processing combines locations. Position, sign and total weight affect direction, response and constant gain. Not every rule should be normalised. <wiki-ref to="weighted-neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先验证横向位置权重，再将同一电路迁移到纵向；非方形图和非对称权重分别检查读取方向与上下位置顺序。
chain.en: Validate horizontal positional weights, then transfer the same circuit to columns; rectangular images and asymmetric weights distinguish direction from above/below order.

naive.zh: 交换左右权重不会改变结果，或者所有权重都必须为正并且总和为 1。
naive.en: Swapping side weights has no effect, or all filters must have positive unit-sum weights.

title.en: Reuse the line along two axes

task.zh: 复用三点加权器，先沿一条轴处理，再沿另一条轴使用同一组权重。目标是二维外积权重，不是两张处理图相加。
task.en: Reuse the weighted line along both axes using the same weights. Match the 2D outer-product rule, not the sum of two processed images.

question.zh: 怎样复用一维处理得到二维邻域，而不遗漏角点？
question.en: How can a 1D construction cover a 2D neighbourhood including corners?

chain.zh: 横向与纵向的位置规则已经分别验证，但一次处理仍只覆盖一条线。现在让两次处理共同覆盖二维邻域。你决定两次处理怎样连接，对比亮点的十字和矩形响应。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The horizontal and vertical positional rules have been tested separately, but each pass still covers one line. Make two passes cover a 2D neighbourhood. Decide how they connect by comparing cross and rectangular impulse responses. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 用单个亮点观察角上的贡献从哪里来；两次处理各沿一条已经掌握的方向。
chain.en: Use an impulse to inspect corner contributions; each pass follows a direction already practised.

chain.zh: 可分离核允许把二维加权分成连续的一维处理，权重形成外积。相加与前后组合不同；只有可分解的核能这样替代。 <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A separable kernel factors into consecutive 1D passes with outer-product weights. Addition is different from composition, and arbitrary kernels need not factor. <wiki-ref to="filter-separability"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 两条轴各处理一次再相加就等于二维平均。
naive.en: Adding independent axis outputs is a 2D average.

title.zh: 同一部件，压低还是增强细节

task.zh: 用已归一化的高斯样本权重平滑，再按给定强度增强原图相对平滑图的带符号细节。另输出平滑改动的大小。
task.en: Smooth with supplied normalised Gaussian sample weights, enhance signed detail at the given strength, and report the magnitude of the smoothing change.

question.zh: 同一个平滑器怎样支持去细节和增强细节两种目标？
question.en: How can one smoother support both detail suppression and enhancement?

chain.zh: 双轴加权已经可用，但补 0 会让恒定图的边缘变暗。先单独更换边界假设：图外维持最近边缘的读数。用恒定图和变化图区分边界效果与平滑效果。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The two-axis filter works, but zero extension darkens constant-image edges. First change only the boundary assumption: outside reads retain the nearest edge value. Contrast constant and varying images to separate boundary effects from smoothing. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 双轴处理器已经能汇合邻居。现在用课程给出的高斯权重处理细碎变化，再把被抑制的细节用于另一种任务。权重和与小数由系统计算，你决定图像之间的关系。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The two-axis processor combines neighbours. Use supplied Gaussian weights to suppress fine variation, then reuse the removed detail for another purpose. Weight arithmetic is supplied; decide the image relationships. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 比较纹理、边缘和常量图。改动大小与要加回的带符号细节承担不同职责。
chain.en: Compare texture, edges and constants. Change magnitude and the signed detail to add back serve different purposes.

chain.zh: 平滑既压低干扰也损失细节。原图减去平滑图得到带符号的细节，增强它与仅显示改动大小不同；强增强也可能放大噪声。 <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Smoothing suppresses nuisance and detail. Original minus smooth retains signed detail. Enhancing it differs from displaying change size, and can amplify noise. <wiki-ref to="smoothing-detail"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 平滑只删除噪声，或增强可以用绝对差代替带符号差。
naive.en: Smoothing removes only noise, or absolute difference can replace signed detail for enhancement.

facet.zh: 将可分离平滑用于带符号细节增强，区别于绝对改动量
facet.en: Use separable smoothing for signed enhancement versus absolute change

title.en: Build a processor with replaceable kernels

task.zh: 造一个接受任意奇数尺寸权重表的局部处理器。展开邻域只给读数和权重；你负责组合它们，并为每个原位置得到一个结果。
task.en: Build a local processor accepting any odd-sized weight table. Unfold windows supplies samples and weights only; combine them and produce one result per original location.

question.zh: 怎样用同一个电路处理不同形状的局部规则？
question.en: How can one circuit implement different local rules?

chain.zh: 三点加权已经把位置与权重分开。现在邻域可以有多行：展开工具为每个输出位置保留一行读数，并给出一一对应的权重；先检查每一路的贡献，再汇合结果。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The line separated sample positions from weights. A neighbourhood can now have several rows: unfolding gives one sample row per output location and matching weights. Inspect contributions before combining them. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 三点加权能处理一条线，但斜向和其他形状需要更一般的邻域。工具把重复取样展开为表，你把刚才学会的加权关系扩展到整张权重表。工具不会替你加权求和。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A line cannot express every diagonal or local pattern. A helper unfolds repeated sampling into tables. Extend the weighted relation to the entire table; the helper does not calculate a weighted sum. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 每行是一处输出的邻域。先检查读数与权重的对应，再决定如何把一行变成一个结果。
chain.en: Each row is one output neighbourhood. Inspect sample/weight correspondence, then decide how to reduce the row.

chain.zh: 同一局部处理器能表达平滑、差分和方向响应；变化的是位置权重，不是重新发明一套接线。书写顺序直接对应邻域时是互相关。 <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: One local processor can express smoothing, differences and directional responses through its weights. Written weights directly matched to the neighbourhood implement correlation. <wiki-ref to="local-kernel"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 权重乘完之后还要再平均一次，或表中每行是一整张新图。
naive.en: Averaging after weighting, or treating each table row as a separate full image.

title.zh: 同一个核，方向为何不同

task.zh: 接口接收数学卷积核。让非对称核的方向与卷积定义一致，保持输出尺寸和零边界。
task.en: The interface receives mathematical convolution kernels. Match their orientation, including asymmetric kernels, with same-size output and zero boundaries.

question.zh: 怎样让处理器执行公式所指的卷积，而不是方向相反的响应？
question.en: How can the processor follow the mathematical convolution convention?

chain.zh: 处理器能处理任意核，但课程公式和一些工具使用不同的核约定。对称平滑核掩盖了差别，现在用非对称核把问题显露出来，再给自己的处理器加上明确的数学接口。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The processor accepts any kernel, but conventions differ. Symmetric smoothing hides that difference. Expose it with an asymmetric kernel and build an explicit mathematical interface. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 用非对称权重表与单个亮点检查方向。翻转核只调整权重表，不是翻转待处理图。
chain.en: Inspect an asymmetric kernel on an impulse. Reverse the weight table, not the image.

chain.zh: 数学卷积相对互相关反转核的两条轴。对称核结果相同，不代表两种定义始终等价。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Mathematical convolution reverses both kernel axes relative to correlation. Agreement on symmetric kernels does not make the definitions identical. <wiki-ref to="convolution-orientation"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 对称模糊结果一致，就认为卷积和互相关没有区别。
naive.en: Assuming convolution and correlation are identical because symmetric blurs agree.

task.zh: 另一个接口只接受邻域完全在原图内的结果。rx、ry 已给出，保留有效内部；不用猜测图外读数。
task.en: Another interface accepts only results whose neighbourhood is fully inside. Supplied rx and ry identify the valid interior; no outside readings are assumed.

question.zh: 怎样避免边界模型制造额外证据？
question.en: How can boundary assumptions avoid creating spurious evidence?

chain.zh: 卷积器在内部工作正常，常量图的边缘却可能变暗。现在明确每项任务的图外模型，再比较同尺寸延续与只保留有效内部这两种接口。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The convolver works inside but may darken constant-image edges. Specify each outside model and distinguish same-size continuation from retaining only valid interior outputs. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 打开自己卷积器的图外假设。观察变化集中在哪些输出位置。
chain.en: Inspect your convolver’s outside setting and where its effects occur.

chain.zh: 补边为未观测位置提供假设，不是恢复真实邻居。有效域避免使用这些位置，但会改变输出尺寸；比较算法等价性时也要匹配边界和域。 <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Padding supplies assumptions, not recovered neighbours. A valid domain avoids outside positions but changes dimensions; equivalence comparisons must match both boundaries and domains. <wiki-ref to="finite-boundaries"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 所有补边只影响外观，或保持原宽高的补边等于 valid。
naive.en: Padding only affects appearance, or same-size padding is equivalent to valid output.

task.zh: 给定横向数学差分核，造出横向和纵向的带符号响应。x 向右、y 向下为正，图外延续边缘。
task.en: Use the supplied horizontal mathematical derivative kernel to produce signed x and y responses. Positive axes are right and down; extend edge readings.

question.zh: 怎样分辨横向、纵向以及相反方向的变化？
question.en: How can axis and sign of change be distinguished?

chain.zh: 卷积器已经有明确的核与边界约定。扫描器还需要知道变化沿哪条轴发生，以及亮度在增大还是减小。用两种单轴斜坡区分这两件事。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The convolver now has explicit kernel and boundary conventions. The scanner needs the axis and sign of change. Distinguish them using single-axis ramps. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先看只有一条轴发生变化的斜坡。核的方向与输出分量的方向应一致。
chain.en: Start with ramps changing along only one axis. Match kernel and component directions.

chain.zh: 梯度分量保留每条轴的局部变化。负号不是无效读数，灰度显示截断也不改变它；方向响应还不能直接当作无方向强度。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Gradient components retain local changes along each axis. Negative values remain valid despite display clipping; directional responses are not yet direction-independent strength. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 把同一张变化图当作两个方向，或者忽略负响应。
naive.en: Using one response for both axes, or discarding negative responses.

title.zh: 给方向响应装上抗干扰结构

task.zh: 将差分响应沿垂直于求导的方向用 [1,2,1] 平滑，得到 Sobel gx、gy，再输出两分量的长度。保留带符号分量。
task.en: Smooth each derivative in its perpendicular direction with [1,2,1] to obtain Sobel gx and gy, then output their length. Retain signed components.

question.zh: 怎样把方向测量组合成稳定、不会因符号抵消的响应？
question.en: How can directional measurements form a stable response without sign cancellation?

chain.zh: 差分器分别测出横向和纵向变化。两分量有正负号，直接相加会互相抵消；向量长度元件自动计算平方和与平方根。先建立强度测量，再处理干扰。 <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The derivative measures horizontal and vertical change separately. Signed components can cancel in a sum; the length component supplies the squared sum and square root. Establish strength before suppressing nuisance. <wiki-ref to="gradient-components"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 单纯差分也会响应细碎干扰。三点加权器可以沿另一条轴汇合读数；将它接到双轴差分器，再把两种方向统一到强度测量。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Raw differences also respond to fine nuisance. Use the weighted-line part along the other axis, then combine both directional responses into a strength measurement. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 把求导轴和去干扰轴分开考虑。长度元件已经提供平方、相加和开方，不要求你手算。
chain.en: Separate the derivative axis from the smoothing axis. Vector length supplies squaring, addition and square root.

chain.zh: Sobel 将差分与垂直方向平滑组合。强度由两个分量共同决定，直接相加会让相反符号抵消；强边缘也不等于已经识别出物体。 <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Sobel combines differentiation with perpendicular smoothing. Strength uses both components; direct addition can cancel signs. Strong responses do not establish recognised objects. <wiki-ref to="sobel-measurement"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 应沿求导轴再次平均，或用 gx+gy 代替长度。
naive.en: Smoothing along the derivative axis, or replacing length with gx+gy.

task.zh: 输入为 RGB 读数。按给定通道贡献输出单通道测量；保留空间位置，权重已给定且无需手算。
task.en: The input contains RGB readings. Combine the supplied channel contributions into one-channel measurements, preserving positions; weights and arithmetic are supplied.

question.zh: 怎样从彩色读数形成扫描器使用的单通道测量？
question.en: How can colour readings become a scalar scanner measurement?

chain.zh: 扫描器将接收彩色图，不能直接把三个颜色读数当作一个标量强度。把已经学会的加权关系用到通道轴，构建可调整的单通道测量。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The scanner will receive colour images. Three colour readings are not one scalar measurement. Reuse weighted combination along the channel axis to build an adjustable single-channel measurement. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 纯红、纯绿、纯蓝测试会分别显示每个通道是否接入。
chain.en: Pure red, green and blue samples expose each channel’s contribution.

chain.zh: 空间聚合与通道聚合沿不同维度组合信息。这里的通道权重是仪器规范，不宣称任意 RGB 编码都等于物理亮度。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Spatial and channel aggregation combine different dimensions. These channel weights are an instrument specification, not a universal physical-luminance claim. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 只取某一通道总能代替颜色组合，或通道混合会移动像素。
naive.en: One channel always suffices, or mixing channels moves pixels.

task.zh: 按仪器规范汇合彩色读数（1/4、1/2、1/4），在测方向前用给定高斯权重平滑，输出 Sobel 强度及严格超过阈值的标记。
task.en: Use channel weights 1/4,1/2,1/4; smooth with supplied Gaussian weights before directional measurement. Output Sobel strength and marks strictly above threshold.

question.zh: 怎样用已经造出的部件处理有干扰的彩色扫描输入？
question.en: How can earned parts process a noisy colour scanner input?

chain.zh: 彩色测量、邻域处理和方向响应都已经由你造出。现在给扫描台装上整条路径：先控制读数与尺度，再测变化，最后按已知规范输出标记。这里不要求检测完整纸张或做透视矫正。 <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: You have built channel measurement, neighbourhood processing and directional responses. Assemble the scanner path: control readings and scale, measure change, then mark according to the specification. Full document detection and perspective correction are outside this task. <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 分别检查单通道读数、平滑图和方向响应，找出干扰第一次被压低的位置。
chain.en: Inspect channel measurement, smoothing and directional responses to locate where nuisance is suppressed.

chain.zh: 大电路可以由已验证的部件组成，但处理顺序、边界与量的含义仍需检查。强响应是后续视觉判断的证据，不是物体类别或完整轮廓。 <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Verified parts make larger circuits manageable, while order, boundaries and quantity meanings remain inspectable. Strong responses are evidence for later vision, not classes or complete contours. <wiki-ref to="scanner-composition"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 把原图直接接入边缘检测，再靠阈值弥补所有干扰。
naive.en: Feeding raw input to edge measurement and relying on thresholding to remove all nuisance.

facet.zh: 汇合通道、平滑、梯度与阈值，定位处理顺序失误
facet.en: Combine channels, smoothing, gradients and thresholds; diagnose order

question.zh: 怎样把局部处理扩展到频率表示并保留空间信息？
question.en: How can frequency representations extend local processing while retaining spatial information?

why.zh: 扫描器已经能处理局部变化，但规则条纹可能遍布整幅图，靠局部平滑还会损失有用细节。这章要造频率分析仪，先构造能与条纹比较的波形。负值表示围绕零变化，不是坏像素。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
why.en: The scanner handles local changes, but periodic stripes span the image and local smoothing may remove useful detail. Build a frequency analyser, beginning with waves to compare against stripes. Negative readings represent variation around zero, not invalid pixels. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

title.zh: 给扫描台装上频率刻度

task.zh: 位置以整行长度为 1，频率是整行的周期数，相位以周计。造一个能够随频率和相位变化的单位幅度余弦波。
task.en: Positions span one row length; frequency is cycles per row and phase is in turns. Build a unit-amplitude cosine wave that responds to frequency and phase.

question.zh: 怎样分别控制重复速度和波形的位置关系？
question.en: How can repetition rate and wave alignment be controlled independently?

chain.zh: 频率分析先需要一把可重复的刻度。余弦元件以“周”为角度单位，1 周回到同一读数，四分之一周与半周落在不同位置；数值由元件计算。先只改变起点，观察波形在周期内怎样排列。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Frequency analysis needs a repeatable basis. Cosine takes turns: one turn returns to the same reading, while quarter and half turns occupy different positions. The component computes values. First change the starting phase and inspect arrangement within one cycle. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 扫描器已经能处理局部变化，但规则条纹可能遍布整幅图，靠局部平滑还会损失有用细节。这章要造频率分析仪，先构造能与条纹比较的波形。负值表示围绕零变化，不是坏像素。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The scanner handles local changes, but periodic stripes span the image and local smoothing may remove useful detail. Build a frequency analyser, beginning with waves to compare against stripes. Negative readings represent variation around zero, not invalid pixels. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先固定相位比较不同周期数，再固定周期数比较不同相位。余弦元件自动完成三角函数计算。
chain.en: Hold phase fixed to compare cycle counts, then hold frequency fixed to compare phases. Cosine supplies the arithmetic.

chain.zh: 频率控制整行中重复多少次，相位控制同一波形的位置关系。记录数值而不仅是灰度显示，才能保留正负与完整波形。 <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Frequency controls repetitions across a row; phase controls alignment of that wave. Numeric values retain signs and complete wave shape beyond grayscale display. <wiki-ref to="wave-parameters"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 频率是统一加到每个位置的偏移。
naive.en: Frequency is an offset added to every position.

task.zh: 让图像读数与指定频率、相位的波形逐格比较，输出每行的平均乘积。不同频率会在整行中互相抵消。
task.en: Compare readings with a specified basis frequency/phase through their mean product per row. Different frequencies cancel over the row.

question.zh: 怎样判断观测中某个频率的贡献？
question.en: How can an observation’s contribution at a frequency be measured?

chain.zh: 波形发生器提供了可比较的刻度，现在让它与观测发生联系。直接看一行平均亮度会漏掉正负抵消的条纹；用匹配波形检验某个频率是否有贡献。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The wave generator provides a basis. Connect it to observations: averaging brightness misses zero-mean stripes. Test a frequency through comparison with its matching wave. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 观察同频与异频信号的逐格乘积。平均自动完成，但必须把观测纳入比较。
chain.en: Inspect products for matching and differing frequencies. Mean is automatic, but the observation must participate.

chain.zh: 平均乘积测量观测在基波方向上的投影。结果既取决于频率，也取决于相位；一个探针响应为零还不能断言该频率不存在。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The mean product measures projection onto a basis wave. It depends on phase as well as frequency; zero response from one probe does not prove frequency absence. <wiki-ref to="frequency-projection"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 探针自己有波形就能测量，或一次零响应等于频率不存在。
naive.en: The basis alone measures the signal, or one zero response proves absence.

title.en: Do not lose stripes to phase

task.zh: 用相差 1/4 周的两路投影测量一个频率。实部使用 cos，虚部使用 −sin，即 cos(角度+1/4周)；再给出系数长度。
task.en: Measure a frequency using projections a quarter turn apart: real uses cos, imaginary uses −sin = cos(angle+1/4 turn). Also output coefficient length.

question.zh: 怎样在条纹发生平移后仍保留频率信息？
question.en: How can frequency information survive stripe translation?

chain.zh: 单频探针在某些平移下没有响应，尽管条纹还在。补上与第一路相差四分之一周的测量，把两路作为同一个系数的两个分量。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A shifted stripe can make one probe silent while remaining visible. Add a quarter-turn projection and retain both components of the same coefficient. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 比较同一条纹平移前后：一条投影可变成零，另一路应保留信息。长度由工具计算。
chain.en: Compare shifted versions of a stripe: one projection can vanish while the other retains information. Length is computed.

chain.zh: 实部和虚部共同记录幅度与相位。长度便于比较频率贡献，却不能代替重建所需的两个带符号分量；普通频率的一对共轭系数共同描述实信号。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Real and imaginary components jointly retain magnitude and phase. Length compares contribution but cannot replace signed components for reconstruction. Conjugate pairs represent real signals. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 重复同一投影可以补齐相位，或系数幅度足够重建原图。
naive.en: Duplicating one projection recovers phase, or magnitude alone reconstructs the image.

title.en: Grow the probe into a spectrum

task.zh: 让自己的探针对每行的 k=0…N−1 全部工作，保留实部、虚部、幅度。展开遍历替你重复读数和生成索引，不替你算系数。
task.en: Run your probe at k=0…N−1 for every row, retaining real, imaginary and magnitude outputs. Expansion supplies repetitions and indices, not coefficients.

question.zh: 怎样把一个频率的测量扩展为完整、仍可重建的表示？
question.en: How can one-frequency measurement become a complete reconstructible representation?

chain.zh: 单频探针已经能测给定的 k。展开遍历把原行重复 N 次，并让 k 在重复行间变化；每行内的位置仍随列变化。两种刻度含义不同，先让探针逐频率工作。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The probe measures a supplied k. Expansion repeats each source row N times and changes k between repetitions; sample position still varies within each row. These indices have different meanings. First run the probe across frequencies. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 单频探针已经可靠。现在由工具展开重复工作，让同一个部件扫描所有离散频率；你负责把读数、频率和输出形状对应起来。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The single-frequency probe works. Expand repeated execution to every discrete frequency using the same part, while keeping observations, frequencies and output shape correctly associated. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先检查展开表中哪一路每行恒定、哪一路随列变化。k=0 的系数应当等于原行平均值。
chain.en: Inspect which table varies by row and which by column. The k=0 coefficient equals the original row mean.

chain.zh: 频谱是同一信号的另一种表示。这里零频率在索引 0，k 与 N−k 构成正负频率对，不把未移中心的数组误读为所有索引都代表更高频率。 <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A spectrum is another representation of the signal. DC is at index 0; k and N−k pair positive and negative frequencies. Increasing unshifted indices do not always mean increasing frequency. <wiki-ref to="discrete-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 把取样位置当作频率索引，或只保留一半而不说明如何恢复。
naive.en: Confusing sample positions with frequency indices, or discarding half the data without a recovery rule.

task.zh: 前向系数已经除以 N。按所有频率合成每个位置：实部乘 cos，虚部乘 sin 后相减；此处波形器可用 +1/4 周产生 −sin，因此相应调整组合符号。不要再平均。
task.en: Forward coefficients already include 1/N. Synthesis sums real·cos − imaginary·sin across frequencies. The wave generator supplies −sin via +1/4 turn; account for that sign. Do not average again.

question.zh: 怎样验证频谱仍保留原图的空间信息？
question.en: How can the spectrum be checked for retained spatial information?

chain.zh: 频谱仪保留了两路系数，还需要一台合成器才能检查它们是否完整。正向测量与逆向重建共用你造出的波形，但它们的求和方向和归一化职责不同。 <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The analyser retains both components. Build a synthesiser to check whether information is complete. Analysis and reconstruction reuse the wave generator but differ in summation roles and normalisation. <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 先用只有 DC 的常量图检查总增益，再用有相位的条纹检查虚部符号。所有乘积与累加自动计算。
chain.en: Check gain using DC-only constants, then imaginary signs using phased stripes. Arithmetic and accumulation are automatic.

chain.zh: 保留完整系数可以重建数值，而不仅是相似的灰度外观。DC、符号和归一化错误会分别暴露在常量、带相位条纹与不同长度的测试中。 <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Complete coefficients reconstruct values, not merely similar grayscale appearance. Constants, phased stripes and varying lengths expose DC, sign and normalisation errors. <wiki-ref to="fourier-synthesis"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 逆向也要平均，或者把虚部符号照搬为同相余弦。
naive.en: Averaging in both directions, or using the wrong imaginary contribution.

title.zh: 幅度相同，位置可以不同

task.zh: 重建时保留 B 的相位关系，使用 A 的频谱幅度。把 B 的两分量一起缩放到 A 的系数长度；零长度使用给定安全下限 10⁻¹²。
task.en: Reconstruct using B’s phase relationships and A’s magnitudes. Scale both B components together to A’s coefficient lengths; use the supplied 10⁻¹² floor for zero lengths.

question.zh: 为什么相同幅度不能唯一确定图像？
question.en: Why do equal magnitudes not uniquely determine an image?

chain.zh: 频率系数的两分量共同确定长度与方向。同一个正比例同时作用于实部和虚部，会改变长度而保留方向；零系数没有可保留的方向。先在系数表上验证，再交换图像的幅度和相位。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A coefficient pair determines length and direction together. One positive scale changes length while retaining direction; a zero pair has no direction to preserve. Verify coefficient rescaling before exchanging image magnitudes and phases. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 重建器可以检验“频率有多少”是否足够。现在交换两张图的幅度来源和相位来源，检查空间结构跟随哪一部分。只在非零系数上讨论相位，零系数的方向没有意义。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Use the synthesiser to test whether frequency amounts alone suffice. Mix magnitude and phase sources and inspect spatial structure. Phase is meaningful for nonzero coefficients; zero coefficients have no direction. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 同一比例缩放实部和虚部会改变长度而保持方向。先比较平移前后的同一形状。
chain.en: Scaling both components equally changes length but preserves direction. Start by comparing a shape with its translation.

chain.zh: 频谱幅度记录贡献大小，相位记录各频率的排列关系。丢失相位不是单纯降低清晰度，可能得到完全不同的空间结构。 <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Magnitude records contribution size; phase records frequency arrangement. Losing phase can change spatial structure, not merely sharpness. <wiki-ref to="phase-structure"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 幅度就是可重建的完整频谱，虚部是无用噪声。
naive.en: Magnitude is the complete reconstructible spectrum and imaginary components are noise.

task.zh: 用给定增益同时调整每个系数的两分量，再重建。增益满足共轭配对；既要支持低通，也要支持去 DC 或带通。
task.en: Apply supplied gains to both coefficient components before reconstruction. Gains preserve conjugate pairing; support low-pass, DC removal and band selection.

question.zh: 怎样改变尺度贡献而不误改相位或漏掉负频率？
question.en: How can scale contributions be changed without corrupting phase or missing negative frequencies?

chain.zh: 重建器让你能够改系数再回到图像。先从频率到零点的距离造增益，再把它接入完整的频率处理路径；不要把相位作为无关数据丢弃。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The synthesiser lets you modify coefficients and return to images. Construct gains from frequency distance, then connect the full filtering path while retaining phase information. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 频率有正负，低通关心离零频率的距离。
chain.en: Frequency has a sign; low-pass depends on distance from zero.

chain.zh: 低通、高通和带通改变保留的尺度。实信号需要成对处理共轭系数；相同非负增益缩放两分量可保留该频率的相位。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Low-, high- and band-pass gains select scales. Real signals need paired conjugate treatment; equal nonnegative gains on both components preserve phase. <wiki-ref to="frequency-filtering"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 只调整实部，或者负索引天然属于低频。
naive.en: Adjusting only real components, or treating every negative index as low frequency.

task.zh: 把同一信号分别送入硬截止与渐变增益，输出两种重建及它们的差异大小。保留小于 0 或大于 1 的原始计算值。
task.en: Process one signal with hard and tapered gains; output both reconstructions and their difference magnitude. Preserve values below 0 or above 1.

question.zh: 为什么删掉高频后仍可能出现新的波纹？
question.en: Why can removing high frequencies still produce ripples?

chain.zh: 频率处理器已经能改变尺度，现在把它用于突变信号。硬截止与渐变处理都可能让图像变平滑，却产生不同的空间响应；用自己的比较器观察差别。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Apply the filter to abrupt signals. Hard and tapered gains can both smooth an image yet produce different spatial responses. Inspect them with your comparator. <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 点开突变附近的格子查看原值。显示截断可能隐藏过冲，不能据此宣称没有振铃。
chain.en: Inspect raw cells near the discontinuity; display clipping can hide overshoot, not eliminate ringing.

chain.zh: 频域的突变对应延展并振荡的空间响应，突变附近可能出现过冲。渐变增益改变这项取舍，也可能额外压低细节；不能声称所有波纹都是噪声。 <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Abrupt frequency changes correspond to extended oscillatory spatial responses and can produce overshoot. Tapering changes the trade-off and may suppress more detail; not every ripple is noise. <wiki-ref to="frequency-ringing"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 频域低通总是没有副作用，显示中没看到过冲就不存在。
naive.en: Low-pass has no side effects, or invisible clipped overshoot does not exist.

facet.zh: 硬增益的振铃与未截断过冲反例
facet.en: Counterexamples expose ringing and unclipped overshoot

task.zh: 空间路径使用周期卷积。频域路径把图像频谱与同一卷积器的单位脉冲响应频谱相乘，再重建；本归一化下系数乘积需要乘 N。输出两条路径及误差。
task.en: The spatial path uses periodic convolution. Multiply the signal spectrum by the spectrum of the convolver’s impulse response, then reconstruct. With this normalisation multiply the coefficient product by N. Output both paths and their error.

question.zh: 怎样证明自己的频域路径实现了同一条空间规则？
question.en: How can the frequency path be verified against the same spatial rule?

chain.zh: 你有空间卷积器和频域处理器，现在让同一个规则走两条路径。先将边界设为周期，避免把不同问题当作算法误差；计算工具处理复数乘法，你核对信息路径。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: You have spatial and frequency processors. Run one rule through both, using periodic boundaries so the comparison is fair. Arithmetic parts handle complex multiplication while you check the information path. <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 脉冲先经过自己的周期卷积器，自动建立核在周期数组中的原点。复数乘积的四项算术已放入起始板。
chain.en: Sending an impulse through your periodic convolver establishes the kernel origin. Four complex-product arithmetic terms are already placed in the starter.

chain.zh: 卷积定理连接空间局部作用与频域乘积。有限图像的核原点、边界和归一化是等价条件的一部分；定理本身不保证任意实现都更快。 <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The convolution theorem connects local spatial action with frequency multiplication. Kernel origin, boundaries and normalisation belong to the equivalence conditions; the theorem alone does not guarantee faster implementations. <wiki-ref to="convolution-theorem"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 把周期频域结果与零边界卷积比较，认为差异就是算法错误。
naive.en: Comparing periodic frequency processing with zero-boundary convolution as if they were the same problem.

title.zh: 让频谱仪接收自己的输出
title.en: Let the analyser receive complex data

task.zh: 中间数据可能已有实部和虚部。分别用自己的频谱仪处理两张实数表，再按 i²=−1 合并，保留完整复数输出。
task.en: Intermediate data may already have real and imaginary parts. Analyse each real-valued table with your analyser, then combine using i²=−1, retaining a complex output.

question.zh: 第二条轴如何保留第一条轴产生的完整信息？
question.en: How can the second axis retain complete first-axis information?

chain.zh: 二维处理要把第一条轴的结果送往第二条轴，它已不再只有实数读数。先扩展现有频谱仪的输入契约，避免第二次处理时丢掉一半信息。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A second image axis receives complex results from the first. Extend the analyser’s input contract before that pass so it does not drop half the information. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 将 (a+ib)(c+id) 的四项贡献分为实部和虚部，i²=−1；算术由元件执行。
chain.en: Group the four contributions of (a+ib)(c+id), using i²=−1. Parts do the arithmetic.

chain.zh: 同一个变换作用于实部和虚部后，仍需按复数运算组合。这里升级的是信息契约，不是发放另一套傅里叶黑盒。 <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Transforming real and imaginary inputs separately still requires complex combination. This extends the data contract while reusing the same construction. <wiki-ref to="complex-transform"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 第二条轴只需处理第一条轴的实部。
naive.en: The second axis needs only the first pass’s real part.

facet.zh: 将已有分析扩展到复数输入，保留两个分量
facet.en: Extend analysis to complex input without losing a component

title.zh: 从一行到两个空间方向
title.en: From rows to two spatial axes

task.zh: 先处理每行，再沿另一条轴处理完整复数结果，最后恢复原来的轴顺序。输入可能是长方形，输出也必须保持相同宽高。
task.en: Transform rows, then the other axis using complete complex results, and restore the original axis order. Rectangular inputs must retain their width and height.

question.zh: 怎样把逐行频谱仪扩展到真正的二维图像？
question.en: How can a row analyser become a true 2D analyser?

chain.zh: 逐行机器不能直接把一列当作一行。行列互换会交换宽高并把 (x,y) 放到 (y,x)，数值不变；复数两分量必须一起交换。用非方形图追踪进入机器和返回接口时的形状。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A row machine cannot directly consume columns. Transpose swaps dimensions and moves (x,y) to (y,x) without changing values; both complex components must move together. Track rectangular shapes into the machine and back to the interface. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 复数频谱仪可以处理上一轮的输出，现在把同一台机器沿两条轴复用。用横纹、竖纹与长方形输入检查频率轴是否对应正确。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: The complex analyser can process its own output. Reuse it along both axes and check frequency axes with horizontal stripes, vertical stripes and rectangular inputs. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 用长方形测试追踪每一步的宽高，同时保留两条复数分量。
chain.en: Track dimensions through the rectangular case and retain both complex components.

chain.zh: 二维频谱同时描述两条空间方向；条纹方向与变化方向不同。这里存储顺序仍未移中心，显示时必须按周期索引理解正负频率。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A 2D spectrum describes both spatial directions. Stripe orientation differs from the direction of variation. Arrays remain unshifted; interpret their frequency indices periodically. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-spectrum"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 第二次仍沿原来的行处理，或不恢复原图轴顺序。
naive.en: Transforming original rows twice, or failing to restore axis order.

task.zh: 复用二维前向机做逆向：共轭输入，做前向变换，再共轭并乘 W×H。共轭保留实部、反转虚部。输出重建实部及虚部残差。
task.en: Reuse the 2D forward machine for inversion: conjugate input, transform, then conjugate and multiply by W×H. Conjugation retains real and negates imaginary parts. Output reconstructed real and imaginary residual.

question.zh: 怎样复用二维机器检查完整重建，而不是只看频谱？
question.en: How can the 2D machine verify complete reconstruction?

chain.zh: 二维频谱仪必须能回到图像，才适合做可检查的处理。逆向的数学恒等式已经给出；复用已有机器并保持完整的实虚数据，观察重建与残差。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: A 2D analyser must return to images for inspectable processing. The inverse identity is supplied; reuse the machine while retaining both components and inspect reconstruction plus residual. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 用常量图检查增益，用长方形图检查 W 与 H。共轭与缩放公式是给定的数学支持。
chain.en: Check gain on constants and W/H on rectangles. Conjugation and scaling identities are supplied mathematical support.

chain.zh: 二维分析和重建组成闭环。实信号与对称增益应当得到接近零的虚部残差；残差也是检查丢分量或破坏共轭对称的工具。 <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: 2D analysis and reconstruction form a loop. Real data with symmetric gains should leave near-zero imaginary residual, which helps diagnose lost components and broken conjugate symmetry. <wiki-ref to="two-dimensional-inverse"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 前向归一化重复使用不影响幅度，或可以静默丢弃非零虚部。
naive.en: Repeated forward normalisation preserves amplitude, or a nonzero imaginary result may be silently discarded.

facet.zh: 复用二维前向机做共轭逆变换并检查残差
facet.en: Reuse 2D analysis for conjugate inversion and residual checks

task.zh: 已知干扰频率的共轭成对增益由仪器给出。用二维频谱机删除这些分量后重建，保留其他频率；同时输出同一周期边界下的局部平滑作为对照。
task.en: The instrument supplies conjugate-paired gains for known interference frequencies. Remove those components with your 2D machine and reconstruct while retaining other frequencies. Also output local smoothing with the same periodic boundary as a comparison.

question.zh: 怎样去掉已知周期干扰，同时尽量保留其他结构？
question.en: How can known periodic interference be removed while preserving other structure?

chain.zh: 扫描台的局部处理器已经有用，却无法专门区分整幅图上的规则条纹。现在把二维分析、频率选择和二维重建接成机器，再与自己的空间处理器做公平对照。测试明确给出干扰位置，不要求猜频率或手算。 <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Local processing helps the scanner but cannot selectively isolate global periodic stripes. Assemble 2D analysis, gain selection and reconstruction, then compare fairly with your spatial processor. Interference locations are supplied; there is no frequency guessing or hand calculation. <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>

chain.zh: 频谱的两分量使用同一增益。先检查重建闭环和虚部残差，再比较局部平滑保留了什么。
chain.en: Apply the same gain to both components. Check reconstruction and imaginary residual before comparing retained details against local smoothing.

chain.zh: 从像素运算到邻域处理，再到频域表示，同一批元件已经长成不同能力的机器。去掉已知频率保留了其他贡献，但干扰与有用信号重叠时仍会损失信息。 <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>
chain.en: Pixel arithmetic has grown into neighbourhood and frequency machines. Removing known frequencies retains others, but useful signal overlapping the interference is still lost. <wiki-ref to="interference-machine"></wiki-ref>

naive.zh: 任何平滑都只删噪声，或指定频率的抑制等于自动理解哪些像素是噪声。
naive.en: Every smoother removes only noise, or suppressing specified frequencies automatically identifies nuisance pixels.

facet.zh: 汇合空间与频域机器，比较周期干扰抑制和细节代价
facet.en: Combine spatial and frequency machines; compare interference removal and detail loss

why.zh: 共同三点基础之后，可分离、一般核与通道三条路线互不使用对方的部件，扫描器才汇合。
why.en: After the line foundation, separable, kernel and channel routes are independent and join in the scanner.

why.zh: 完整频谱之后，逐行合成与二维扩展互不需要对方新造的部件；去干扰机使用两路结果。
why.en: After the spectrum, row synthesis and 2D extension are independent; interference removal consumes both routes.

about.zh: 相机、学习、匹配、生成、分割、检测等后续阶段
about.en: Later camera, learning, matching, generation, segmentation and detection stages

why.zh: 遵照完整大纲，在后续机器真正需要时构建。
why.en: Build where later machines actually require them, following the full outline.
